foreground.advice: Set disableAgentView to true in Claude's user settings.json (merge {"disableAgentView":true} into the existing object), or set env.CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AGENT_VIEW to "1" there. This disables agent view, --bg/background and on-demand daemon mode. CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_TASKS is a different setting and does not replace this choice.
foreground.explanation: herdr-threads requires each managed agent to remain in its pane: a shared harness server may run hooks/tools with its own pane environment instead of the TUI environment used for seat attribution. Setup inspects user settings and changes a foreground setting only through an owned component the user explicitly consents to, where the advice names one. User settings, environment and launch arguments are not proof of execution; project/managed settings, other shells, and wrapper behavior may override them.

mod.note: an install does not prove any session loaded the mod

setup.note: installed is not observed: run `herdr-threads doctor` for native evidence. Claude sessions that run with another CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, or with --setting-sources excluding `user`, do not load these hooks

permissions.note: agents are asked before each herdr-threads command: re-run `herdr-threads setup claude --with-permissions` to let them run herdr-threads commands without prompting (the person and setup commands keep asking), or --without-permissions to keep it this way

warnings: Claude Code shows a dim prompt suggestion in its input box after every turn (on by default). herdr-threads tells it from text you typed by its dim style, so wakes and soft-deadline reminders (pokes) still reach an idle Claude pane that shows one. Where Herdr's styled screen read fails, the suggestion counts as typed text and only the hard-deadline warning reaches the pane; with prompt suggestions off (`promptSuggestionEnabled: false` in Claude's user settings), an idle Claude pane reads empty either way. unsetup reverts the setting if setup set it. Prompt suggestions are on in <root>/claude config/settings.json and were left unchanged: re-run `herdr-threads setup claude --disable-prompt-suggestions` to turn them off (or turn off Prompt suggestions in Claude's /config), or pass --keep-prompt-suggestions to keep them without this note
